name: Stolokrosuchus
sum: Stolokrosuchus is a crocodyliform with a gharial-like tubular snout from the Early Cretaceous Elrhaz Formation of Niger.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: MNN GDF600, an almost complete skull, with a right angular and a left mandible found nearby.
material: The holotype plus isolated teeth from the same site.
biology: The narrow, highly elongated snout resembles that of living gharials; the sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Larsson and Gado 2000
